text.value:
SELECT SUM(numrows) 
as NumRows
  FROM (
  SELECT TOP 2 COUNT(*) as numrows, CAST([ProcessedDate] as date) as ProcessDate, sourceName 
  FROM [tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly] 
  WHERE CAST([ProcessedDate] as date) >=  (DATEADD(d,-210,GETDATE()))  
  AND sourceName IN ('IM03','IM04')
  GROUP BY CAST([ProcessedDate] as date), sourceName
  ORDER BY CAST([ProcessedDate] as date) desc, sourceName
  ) as t

Update tbl_OTC_DerivSett_RMU_RER
set Loaddate =  cast(getdate() as datetime2)
Where Loaddate  = '' OR Loaddate is null

text.value:
Update tbl_OTC_DerivSett_RMU_RER_historical
set Loaddate =  cast(getdate() as datetime2)
Where Loaddate  = '' OR Loaddate is null

SELECT AVG([NUM_RECORDS_INSERTED_UPDATED]) as AvgRecCount 
  FROM [Utility].[dbo].[tbl_SSIS_LOG] 
  WHERE [PROC_NM_OR_SSIS_PACKAGE_NM] = 'OTC_DerivSett_RMU_RER' 
  AND COMMENT = 'Final Report Count' 
  AND NUM_RECORDS_INSERTED_UPDATED != 0
  AND START_DATETIME < (GETDATE()) AND START_DATETIME > (DATEADD(d,-210,GETDATE()))

SELECT SUM(AvgRecCount) as AvgRecCount
 FROM (
		SELECT AVG(rownums) as AvgRecCount 
		FROM (
				SELECT Count(*) as rownums 
				FROM [tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly]  
				WHERE CAST([ProcessedDate] as date) < (GETDATE()) AND CAST([ProcessedDate] as date) > (DATEADD(d,-210,GETDATE()))
				AND sourceName IN ('IM03')
				GROUP BY CAST([ProcessedDate] as date), sourceName
			 ) as tIM03
UNION ALL
		SELECT AVG(rownums) as AvgRecCount 
		FROM (
				SELECT Count(*) as rownums 
				FROM [tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly]  
				WHERE CAST([ProcessedDate] as date) < (GETDATE()) AND CAST([ProcessedDate] as date) > (DATEADD(d,-210,GETDATE()))
				AND sourceName IN ('IM04')
				GROUP BY CAST([ProcessedDate] as date), sourceName
			 ) as tIM04
	) as t

sMessageAccnt.defaultValue: SELECT Account as New_Accounts_Found FROM dbo.tbl_OTC_DerivSett_RMU_RER_Accounts_Staging WHERE Account <> '' AND Account is NOT NULL

sLastThirtydays.defaultValue:
SELECT 
distinct max(ProcessedDate) as ProcessedDate, 
Filename, 
Max(reconDate) reconDate ,
recCnt_After, 
recCnt_Before
FROM tbl_Intellimatch_GL_Monthly_Historical
WHERE 
reconDate is not null 
and reconDate <> '' 
AND cast(ProcessedDate as date) >= (getdate() - 30)
GROUP BY  Filename,  recCnt_After,recCnt_Before
order by ProcessedDate desc
